whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Aesthetic Fitness Studio,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.8★ reviews in South Shivpuri, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke fitness studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://aesthetic-fitness-studio-demo.local

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Aesthetic Fitness Studio team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top-rated training programs in South Shivpuri, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
